findings: Six candidate-core rapid-switch failures across all engines and both plugins: both final media at time 0 and paused. Candidate source switch snapshots playing after its predecessor paused internally, losing the original intent.

One WebKit published-core plus candidate-audio rapid-switch failure: video continues, audio paused and only corrected by seeking. canplay/seeked readiness and resume ordering need a targeted reproduction.
One WebKit published/published offset boundary failure: currentTime 16.01 versus asserted exact 16. Requires native media comparison; do not attribute to the refactor.
limitations: 28 passes and 8 failures; no release acceptance
No real network starvation or physical device evidence yet
Original source and artifact runtimes are unchanged from Audio-04
